payload.inner_binding: request contract_sha256 is the scientific contract; no policy digest is model-visible

local_send_consistency.scope: the bytes handed to HTTPSConnection.send equal the admitted serialized body; not a remote-input attestation

outbound_envelope.evidence_scope: serialized entity-body consistency against the contract rendering; no remote-input or inference attestation

remote_receipt.scope: provider-side receipt is unobservable in live mode

payload.evidence_scope: a 2xx provider status is evidence that the request was authenticated and processed; it is not a digest-matched receipt of a particular credential, and 4xx/5xx statuses other than 401 are not receipts either
